note: The translator agent 'Doddy 6 · Tłumacz (bez żadnych funkcji)' (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-translator-agent.md). A translator conversation (Home › Translate, or 'Doddy, tłumacz mi rozmowę z …' in a normal one, which starts a new conversation) talks to this agent, never to the main one, so it has no tools to call: nothing to look up, nothing to run, and nothing the model could answer instead of translating. The app asks the token server for it with {"agent":"translator"} (server/voice-token); the server's DEFAULT_TRANSLATOR_AGENT_ID and the app's VoiceConfig.translatorDirectAgentID must equal elevenlabs.agent_id here, which voice_agent_spec.py --agent translator checks.

variables.translator_start: The mode, the two languages and the rules, built by the app (TranslatorPrompt.render in DoddyCore). Always set for this agent.
variables.opening_line: Always empty: the translator says nothing until someone speaks (owner, 9 Nov 2026).

elevenlabs.created: 2026-11-12, duplicated from the main agent (same voice, language presets, authentication and overrides), then its prompt replaced, its 115 tools detached and the settings below changed
elevenlabs.reasoning_note: none gave the right language for 4 of 8 Hindi questions, low for 8 of 8, at the same first-audio time (median 1.34 s) in typed checks on 12 Nov 2026.
elevenlabs.built_in_tools_note: language_detection only switches the listening and speaking language to the one being spoken, which the other person's language needs; end_call and skip_turn are off, so nothing ends or skips a conversation but the user's End.
elevenlabs.soft_timeout: off (the filler 'No…' was spoken before translations)

tts.note: No second voice and no audio tags: the model wrapped translations in <Patryk>…</Patryk> and added [slow].

client_overrides.note: The same overrides as the main agent, and the client cannot change the tool list.

elevenlabs.language_presets: One per language in 'languages' besides the agent's own Polish, each overriding only the first message ({{opening_line}}), copied from the main agent.

privacy.note: Same as the main agent: ElevenLabs keeps its own recording, as the translator's privacy text says. Whether to turn recording off for this agent is the owner's decision.
